notes.title: Version 1.4 Now Live!
notes.notes:
https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2016/02/mj140.png

Version 1.40 makes several balance adjustments! Full notes below.


Balance:
Attacks now have a 10% minimum hit chance (previously, 0% hit chance was possible).
Slightly lowered overall hit chance for all attacks.
Single Hit Cannon type attacks are now more likely to miss against all types of enemies.
Lone Rider changed from Common to Uncommon rarity.
Scientist changed from Common to Uncommon rarity.
Lone Gourmet now heals for 100 (up from 25).
Fun Party now heals for 70 (up from 35).

Fixes:
Lone Driver is now called Lone Rider.
